fields.title: 📖 Īmān is word and deed
fields.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Idrīs ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Īmān is word and deed; it increases and decreases.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Aqīdah** of Ahlus-Sunnah does not separate Īmān from action. Īmān is ***affirmation, deed, and change*** — it grows and becomes weaker.

immutable.source: 📝 adh-Dhahabī, Siyar Aʿlām an-Nubalāʾ, Tarjamat ash-Shāfiʿī, Band 10, S. 33.
